title: 40,000 Logs in 3 Mins! INSANE All Wood Farm for Minecraft 1.21/26.4+!
description: In this Tutorial, I'll show you how to build the next generation of all-wood tree farming with the new tech. This new version updates and improves farm efficiency by 30%, adds a new bone meal system, and, best of all, removes every single redstone part, using only boat clocks for the farm. This farm can be used for the upcoming wood poplar, which makes this farm a great choice as your tree farm for Minecraft!
author: TheySix
